test_env_var_affects_flag: test the GTestEnvVarTest.testEnvVarAffectsFlag method that verifies environment variables affect corresponding Google Test flags
test_xml_output_file: test the GTestEnvVarTest.testXmlOutputFile method that verifies XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable affects the output flag
test_xml_output_file_override: test the GTestEnvVarTest.testXmlOutputFileOverride method that verifies GTEST_OUTPUT overrides XML_OUTPUT_FILE

set_environment_variable: set or unset environment variables using SetEnvVar to control Google Test behavior during testing
